parameters.query: SET @u = (SELECT id FROM app_users WHERE phone = $8 AND profile_complete = 1); INSERT INTO teams (code, sport, name, short_name, logo_key, area, city, captain_user_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, @u); SET @t = LAST_INSERT_ID(); INSERT INTO team_members (team_id, user_id, role, position, added_by) VALUES (@t, @u, $9, IF($9 = 'COACH', NULL, (SELECT s.role FROM app_user_sports s WHERE s.user_id = @u AND s.sport = $2)), @u); SELECT code FROM teams WHERE id = @t

UPDATE teams t JOIN team_members m ON m.team_id = t.id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role IN ('COACH', 'CAPTAIN', 'VICE_CAPTAIN') JOIN app_users u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.phone = $7 SET t.name = $2, t.short_name = $3, t.logo_key = $4, t.area = $5, t.city = $6 WHERE t.code = $1; SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teams WHERE code = $1) AS found, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members m JOIN teams t ON t.id = m.team_id JOIN app_users u ON u.id = m.user_id  WHERE t.code = $1 AND u.phone = $7 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role IN ('COACH', 'CAPTAIN', 'VICE_CAPTAIN')) AS can_edit
